Checks.Name: the add-in registers over the well-known pipe
the registering process is the one that was launched
the registration names the right release
the caller is this account
the registry verified the peer against its pipe
the registry knows it was started by us
the registry is watching it for exit
a pipe server lives inside the Revit process
its image is the Revit that was started
a registry that lost everything finds it again by enumeration
the recovered instance is the same one
recovery reads the release out of the pipe name
a recovered instance is never claimed as ours
GetConfiguration is answered from inside Revit
the probe saw the correlation token
the snapshot names the contract it speaks
what Revit publishes arrives as ordinary configuration
a change streams out of Revit to the consumer
the change token fired
sections bind
the call arrives off the Revit API thread
the product layer is the add-in's own folder, not Revit's
a settings file on disk is read inside Revit
the release-specific layer overrules the common one
nine files and the environment are looked at, existing or not
the add-in writes a log file inside Revit
the file is the one findable by process id
the journal sink attached, which needs the API thread
the journal sink attached exactly once, however many hosts
the journal takes warnings and worse only
nothing is being dropped
the log records which assemblies actually loaded
records are marked with the thread they were written on
the ribbon panel and button were built
and they came from the generated manifest, not from code
the feature assembly is not loaded while the ribbon stands
a DBApplication add-in starts the same host
and it is keyed by its own add-in id, beside the interface one
both add-in ids are found in the registry
and they are two hosts, not one answering twice
the interface host offers the API thread and the DB host does not
both forms were called on the same API thread
a module starts in the DB host too
and it is given its own settings section
startup there is not yet Revit having started, as in the interface form
settings from disk are read there too
asking for the API thread there is refused, in a sentence
and Revit tells it that it has finished starting, session or no session
every assembly Revit substituted is one RefCheck vets
the diagnostic stream carries what Revit is doing
every phase arrived on Revit's API thread
the publisher accounted for everything it dropped
Revit closes on an ExitRevit posted from inside
the registry drops it when the process goes
the DB host is taken down on the way out, like the interface one
and its module is stopped with it
